mapper.sql: commissions.id AS id, commissions.location_group_id AS warehouseId, location_groups.name AS warehouseName, commissions.description AS description, commissions.code AS code, commissions.recurring AS recurring, commissions.`start` AS startDate, commissions.`end` AS endDate, commissions.note AS note, commissions.type AS type, commissions.target AS target, commissions.amount AS amount, commissions.percent AS percent, commissions.status AS status, commissions.created AS created, CONCAT(creator.first_name, ' ', creator.last_name) AS createdBy, commissions.modified AS modified, CONCAT(editor.first_name, ' ', editor.last_name) AS modifiedBy

FROM commissions LEFT JOIN location_groups ON location_groups.id = commissions.location_group_id LEFT JOIN users AS creator ON creator.id = commissions.created_by LEFT JOIN users AS editor ON editor.id = commissions.modified_by
mapper.select: SELECT commission_details.id AS id, commission_details.product_id AS productId, products.name AS productName, products.code AS sku, products.barcode AS upc, commission_details.qty AS qty, commission_details.uom_id AS uomId, uoms.name AS uomName, uoms.abbr AS uomAbbr, commission_details.amount AS amount, commission_details.percent AS percent, commission_details.unit_price AS unitPrice FROM commission_details LEFT JOIN products ON products.id = commission_details.product_id LEFT JOIN uoms ON uoms.id = commission_details.uom_id WHERE commission_details.commission_id = #{commissionId}

SELECT employees.id AS id, employees.name AS name FROM commission_employees INNER JOIN employees ON employees.id = commission_employees.employee_id WHERE commission_employees.commission_id = #{commissionId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commissions ( location_group_id, description, `start`, `end`, note, type, recurring, target, amount, percent, created, created_by, location_group_apply, status ) VALUES ( #{commission.locationGroupId}, #{commission.description}, #{commission.startDate}, #{commission.endDate}, #{commission.note}, #{commission.type}, #{commission.recurring}, #{commission.target}, #{commission.amount}, #{commission.percent}, NOW(), #{commission.createdBy}, #{commission.locationGroupApply}, 1 )
mapper.update: UPDATE commissions SET location_group_id = #{commission.locationGroupId}, description = #{commission.description}, `start` = #{commission.startDate}, `end` = #{commission.endDate}, note = #{commission.note}, type = #{commission.type}, recurring = #{commission.recurring}, target = #{commission.target}, amount = #{commission.amount}, percent = #{commission.percent}, location_group_apply = #{commission.locationGroupApply}, modified = NOW(), modified_by = #{commission.modifiedBy} WHERE id = #{commission.id} AND status >= 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO commission_details ( commission_id, product_id, qty, uom_id, amount, percent, unit_price ) VALUES ( #{detail.commissionId}, #{detail.productId}, #{detail.qty}, #{detail.uomId}, #{detail.amount}, #{detail.percent}, #{detail.unitPrice} )
